verdict.rationale: New Relic documents its own AI summarization: AI insights give 'AI-powered summaries' of workload health, performance trends and potential issues. Its AI assistant also helps users troubleshoot issues in plain language. Nothing ties these summaries to specific incidents or alert context delivered to responders, so support is thin and only partly on-story. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated summaries of incidents/alerts, alert-context enrichment for responders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.
It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
